description: This file defines a class 'MySQLi' which provides an interface for database operations using MySQLi extension in PHP. It includes methods for establishing a connection, executing queries, escaping strings, and managing connection state, with support for SSL options.

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: A PHP class providing MySQL database connection and query execution functionalities with SSL support and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MySQLi connection using provided options, handling SSL setup and setting session variables.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns a result object or boolean, with internal handling of query results.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted auto-increment ID.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up SSL temporary files when the object is destroyed.
